title: Ferrari Marketing Executive
description:
Ferrari ownership is about far more than the car itself. It is an experience shaped by emotion, anticipation, personal connection and attention to every detail. As a Ferrari Marketing Executive, you will play a central role in bringing that experience to life, ensuring every client interaction reflects the exceptional standards, care and attention synonymous with the Ferrari brand. Working closely with Sales, After Sales and Marketing, you will help create memorable experiences both within the dealership and through a programme of exclusive events and client activities.

The Role

As Ferrari Marketing Executive, you will take ownership of the customer journey, shaping how clients and prospects experience the brand from their first interaction through to vehicle delivery and beyond. You will be a highly visible and engaging presence within the dealership, building trusted client relationships, creating a welcoming and premium showroom environment, hosting experiences and events, and helping to foster a strong and connected Ferrari community.

You will play an active role in the planning, organisation and delivery of local events and customer initiatives, bringing ideas and initiative to help shape engaging experiences. Working closely with the Marketing Manager, you will support event concepts, guest selection and invitations, supplier coordination, budgets, on-the-day execution and post-event follow-up. You will help use these opportunities to engage existing clients, attract new prospects and strengthen long-term customer loyalty, while ensuring every activity is delivered to the highest standards and in line with Ferrari's brand guidelines.

You will also take ownership of the dealership's social media presence, creating and coordinating engaging content that showcases Ferrari, our clients, events, experiences and community. Working within Ferrari's brand guidelines, you will manage the social media calendar, coordinate content and monitor engagement, ensuring our digital presence reflects the same level of quality and exclusivity as the in-person Ferrari experience.

In addition, you will oversee relevant digital marketing activity, including website content, email campaigns and paid digital initiatives, supporting customer acquisition, engagement and retention. You will monitor the effectiveness of marketing and event activity, evaluating customer engagement, acquisition, loyalty and return on investment to continually identify opportunities for improvement.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organised, creative and naturally personable individual to become a key ambassador for Ferrari, creating exceptional experiences, developing lasting client relationships and helping to shape the next chapter of our Ferrari community.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.

title: Senior Communications & Marketing Officer
description:
Summary

Are you a creative storyteller? Do you like creating inspiring content across a range of platforms using different media? If so, we're looking for a Senior Communications and Marketing Officer to plan and lead our communications and marketing for Munstead Wood. This is an exciting time to join a new National Trust project, with the opportunity to shape and develop the storytelling for this special place from the very beginning.

Salary: £17,620.20 per annum pro rated (£29,367 FTE)

Contract Duration: Fixed term until 31st October 2028

Working Pattern: You will work 22.5 hours per week, with a flexible working pattern. Your hours may vary depending on operational requirements, but evening/weekend work will be rare. Where this is required, time off in lieu will be provided.

Interviews will be held on Monday 26th October at Munstead Wood

If you have any queries or would like to learn more about this role please email: .uk What it's like to work here

Munstead Wood is an exciting recent acquisition for the National Trust. The personal home of garden designer and prolific content creator Gertrude Jekyll, it was designed in collaboration with Edwin Lutyens.

Based at the property in Godalming, you'll be part of a small on-property team looking after the day-to-day needs and running of the property, which is not currently open to the public. There is also an active project team working through the design and planning phase, developing detailed proposals and fundraising to support this work. As part of the on-property team, you'll develop and support communications around this exciting and evolving project. You will need to be able to work regularly on-site.

What you'll be doing

You'll create a dynamic communications plan for this evolving project, leading the development and delivery of original content to support its key messages and themes across a range of communication channels. You'll bring fresh, creative ideas to life, telling the stories of this inspirational place of creativity in ways that connect with audiences around the world.

This is a dynamic and collaborative role, working with stakeholders from across the organisation and externally. You'll bring together diverse expertise to create high-quality content across multiple strands of activity, ensuring work is delivered efficiently and to a consistently high standard.

Who we're looking for

We'd love to hear from you if you have:
- experience creating captivating content using different media across all platforms, and for a range of audiences
- the ability to work collaboratively and flexibly, both independently and as part of a team
- experience building relationships and working with internal and external stakeholders
- experience building dynamic communications plans for evolving projects
- strong proof-reading skills

The package

The National Trust has the motto 'For everyone, for ever' at its heart. We're working hard to create an inclusive culture, where everyone feels they belong. It's important that our people reflect and represent the diversity of the communities and audiences we serve. We welcome and value difference, so when we say we're for everyone, we want everyone to be welcome in our teams too.
